item.title: Nine new DLC characters teased for Dragon Ball: Sparking Zero
item.description: <p><a href='https://www.youtube.com/@BandaiNamcoAmerica'>Bandai Namco Entertainment America</a> released a new trailer for Dragon Ball: Sparking Zero earlier today. It teased a bunch of new content coming to the game in the near future.</p> <p>Though Dragon Ball: Sparking Zero featured a roster of 182 characters at launch, it would seem that there's still somehow room for even more combatants. A number of interesting DLC fighters were confirmed and teased during this latest trailer.</p>

item.title: That hilarious glitch that has Ryu sucker punching Ken with a surprise fireball... then rips his hand off?
item.description: <p>Back in late 2018, <a href='https://x.com/tenten_ZERO3/status/1051068322383421441'>TenTen_ZERO3</a> highlighted a hilarious glitch for Street Fighter Alpha 3. This glitch requires Ryu ending a match against Ken with his V-ism combo. Upon doing this, a special animation will have Ryu offering Ken a helping hand.</p> <p>However, it seems that Ryu's intentions are not quite as they may appear. Rather than helping him up, Ryu instead holds Ken steady as the off-screen fireball inches closer...</p

item.title: 'We are just getting started' — Bandai Namco celebrates second anniversary of Tekken 8
item.description: <p><a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/tekken8/'>Tekken 8</a> was originally released worldwide on January 26, 2024. Indeed, we've now hit the two-year mark since the game was made available to everyone.</p> <p>The final character of the Season 2 Pass, <a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/oct/12/tekken-8-miary-zo-trailer/'>Miary Zo</a>, was released back in December 2025. As such, fans are now eagerly waiting on news regarding Season 3 content.</p>

item.title: Anissa and Lucan's gameplay trailer revealed for Invincible Vs
item.description: <p>The Anissa and Lucan gameplay trailer for <a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/news/invincible-vs/'>Invincible Vs</a> has dropped. item.title: Dan Forden talks about how he just started cracking up when they first got Johnny Cage throwing moves in Mortal Kombat

item.title: Alex is getting a second theme for Street Fighter 6, and of course it's a new version of Jazzy NYC
item.description: <p>Although <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/21/alex-gameplay-trailer-sf6/">Alex is still a couple months away from releasing in Street Fighter 6</a>, we've been seeing and also hearing a lot of what the big boy is going to be bringing to the table.</p> <p>Capcom just revealed that Alex will have two battle themes in <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/">Street Fighter 6</a>, and his second one should sound very familiar to fans of the Street Fighter 3 games.</p>

item.title: New 2XKO hotfix update brings fixes to the game, but also resets everyone's online rank as players ask for PS5 improvements
item.description: <p>After many years of waiting, <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/19/season-1-patch-notes-2xko/">2XKO finally hit its full release last week</a>, but it seems the launch hasn't exactly been smooth sailing for the players or developers.</p> <p>Riot Games has now released a new hotfix update for 2XKO today to try and address some of the issues while console players are still requesting more improvements.</p>
